Agent actions: Added src/hybrid-handoff.ts (policy s05-hybrid-handoff@1), a lead-in role window and role-handoff exit in ProceduralSource, a one-off fade length in RecordedSource, SmallPlayer.scheduleHybrid with handoff phases, the DJ handoff option and a page selector (tested source a9fa01d).; Added 13 Node tests, four native offline groups and one live browser stage.; An independent read-only reviewer found three issues (B reported started 8 s early and queue head consumed at bridge entry; bridge state not re-checked on re-serve; no end-exit headroom check); all were corrected and rechecked.; Wrote docs/S05_HYBRID.md, the S05 handoff and review, EM-DEC031, status owners; board updated through boards batch submit (d2ef44b).; Abandoned the stale uncommitted NAV run emf-nav-maint-20261105-s05 (files restored to HEAD with an external-review receipt) and ran emf-nav-maint-20261105-s05b against the final source: queue-complete, 63 records, maintenance no-op.
Outcome: S05 is implemented and documented on work/emf-s05-handoff-20261105; main is to be fast-forwarded to it with a plain push.
